faq.title: Frequently Asked Architectural Questions (FAQ)
faq.desc: Direct technical answers outlining the engineering approach used to solve complex backend challenges
faq.q1: How do you enforce tenant data isolation in Multi-Tenant SaaS?
faq.a1: I enforce database query isolation using a Tenant ID Middleware combined with EF Core Global Query Filters to automatically scope all data reads/writes and prevent cross-tenant leaks.
faq.q2: How do you solve server vs. client timezone mismatches across countries?
faq.a2: By standardizing all database timestamps in UTC, leveraging EF Core ValueConverters on read/write, and applying the tenant's custom local timezone before evaluating shift schedules or biometric punches.
faq.q3: How does the Dynamic Workflow Engine eliminate hardcoded approval paths?
faq.a3: By processing business conditions (amounts, days, department) at runtime using a Runtime Rules Evaluator, allowing administrators to modify complex approval routes directly from UI without code deployment.
faq.q4: How compliant is the Payroll & EOSB engine with Saudi Labor Law?
faq.a4: The engine is fully compliant with Saudi Labor regulations, supporting End of Service (EOSB) calculations based on tenure and contract termination reasons, SIF bank file exports, and historical payroll locks.

modal1.title: Multi-Tenant SaaS & Decoupled Timezone Architecture
modal1.content:
In complex enterprise platforms serving tenants globally, tenant isolation and server timezone drift present major risks. This architecture decouples hosting server clock from tenant local business logic.


Core Architectural Pillars:

  • Tenant Isolation Protocol: Applied Tenant ID Middleware with EF Core Global Query Filters to enforce strict tenant database query isolation.
  • UTC Standard: All timestamps stored in UTC formatted with ISO 8601 'Z' suffix across all services.
  • EF Core Converters: Custom value converters preserving DateTimeKind.Utc on read and write.
  • Tenant-Local Business Logic: Resolves tenantProvider.GetTenantTimeZone() dynamically before evaluating local shifts and attendance logs.

modal2.title: Dynamic Enterprise Workflow & Approval Engine
modal2.content:
A flexible runtime workflow engine eliminating hardcoded approval routes across all enterprise modules (Zero Hardcoded Flows).


Technical Highlights:

  • Runtime Rules Processor: Evaluates complex business conditions (amounts, days, department) at runtime to calculate exact approval paths.
  • Task Inbox Lifecycle: Manages full task lifecycle (Approve, Reject, Request Info, Delegate, Rescind).
  • Approval Delegation Framework: Enables temporary approval delegation within UTC date windows with full audit logging.
  • Self-Approval Prevention Rule: Security rule preventing employees/managers from approving their own requests, routing to next management tier.
  • SLA Auto-Escalation & Realtime SignalR: Escalates overdue pending tasks automatically on SLA timeouts with real-time SignalR notifications and chat.

modal3.title: Advanced Hybrid Penalty & Disciplinary Engine
modal3.content:
Automates labor law disciplinary policies without manual bias or calculation errors.


Technical Highlights:

  • Automated Escalation: Escalates penalty degrees (1st written warning, 1-day deduction, 2-day deduction, suspension) based on violation history.
  • Attendance Linkage: Converts unauthorized tardiness and absence into draft disciplinary actions automatically.
  • Appeals Path: Formal objection route evaluated via approval engine before payroll deduction execution.

modal4.title: Attendance Processing & Overnight Shift Engine
modal4.content:
Processes millions of raw biometric log punches and solves overnight shift overlaps across midnight.


Technical Highlights:

  • Overnight Mapping Algorithm: Intelligently maps next-day morning check-outs to previous night shift schedules across midnight boundaries.
  • Log Deduplication: Deduplicates rapid multi-device punches within configurable buffer windows.
  • Overtime & Lateness Pipeline: Calculates late arrivals, early departures, and overtime multipliers for payroll integration.

modal5.title: Contract Versioning & End of Service (EOSB) Engine
modal5.content:
Tracks contract financial revisions immutably while automating End of Service Benefit settlements.


Technical Highlights:

  • Immutable Versioning: Spawns new contract version on financial edits while freezing historical records for legal compliance.
  • EOSB Settlement Engine: Computes final settlements based on Saudi Labor Law Articles 84 & 85 (tenure, contract type, and termination reason).

modal6.title: Financial Payroll Engine & Bulk Processing Architecture
modal6.content:
Bulk financial pipeline processing salaries, allowances, and loans for thousands of employees with historical locks and SIF bank exports.


Technical Highlights:

  • Bulk Assignment Pipeline: Assigns financial components to thousands of employees in seconds with optimized query execution.
  • Automated Deduction Linkage: Pulls approved loans and penalty deductions automatically into payroll runs.
  • Payroll Lock & SIF Export: Freezes historical runs to prevent reverse modifications and exports bank-compliant SIF files.
